context.heading: What "nonpartisan" means here
paragraphs: In a nonpartisan race, party labels do not appear beside candidate names on the ballot. A candidate may still have a publicly documented political affiliation.
Voter-registration affiliation, ballot party, and participation in a party primary are different facts. Each affiliation label identifies the evidence that supports it.
County, state, and federal sections also include partisan races. Consult official election materials for the contests on your ballot.

items.question: Are all races in this directory nonpartisan?
items.answer: No. Party labels do not appear beside candidate names in nonpartisan races, and the directory also includes partisan county, state, and federal races.

items.question: Does a listed affiliation mean the candidate is officially running as a party nominee?
items.answer: Not necessarily. The directory includes races with different ballot rules. A publicly documented political affiliation does not establish nomination status, so consult official election materials for the specific race.

items.question: How was this information verified?
items.answer: Registered affiliation, ballot party, primary participation, and election results are supported by different sources.

items.question: Why are some candidates listed under primary history?
items.answer: Candidates in primary history participated in the primary and are not currently listed for the general election. Each card identifies non-advancement, withdrawal, or absence from the final list when a source supports the status.

items.question: What happens if an affiliation changes?
items.answer: An entry should be updated when a reliable public source documents an affiliation change. Each card shows when its source was reviewed.

items.question: Does this site endorse candidates?
items.answer: Inclusion in this directory does not indicate a Example County GOP endorsement. Candidates receive the same sourcing and presentation standards.

items.question: How can an error be corrected?
items.answer: Send a supporting public source to the correction contact listed under "Sources, review, and corrections".
